definitions.explanation: a breath; a rest; a breather
in one breath; all at once; without stopping

examples.japanese: ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧{一息|ひといき}つこう。
⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{合間|あいま}→合間：05708_aima⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一息|ひといき}⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: To take a break between work.

examples.japanese: ⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧{一息|ひといき}ついた。
examples.english: I had some coffee and took a breather.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一息|ひといき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飲|の}み{干|ほ}した→飲み干す：21473_nomihosu⟧。
examples.english: He drank the beer in one gulp.

examples.japanese: ⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一息|ひといき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駆|か}け{上|あ}がった→駆け上がる：06110_kakeagaru⟧。
examples.english: I ran up the stairs without stopping.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一息|ひといき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}き{上|あ}げた→書き上げる：06978_kakiageru⟧。
examples.english: I wrote the letter in one sitting.

notes:
{一息|ひといき} literally means "one breath" and has two distinct uses depending on context.

SENSE 1 — TAKING A BREAK:
- {一息|ひといき}つく: to take a breather, to catch one's breath
- {一息|ひといき}⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to take a short break
- {一息|ひといき}ついて⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: after taking a breather

SENSE 2 — ALL AT ONCE:
- {一息|ひといき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in one go, without stopping (adverbial)
- {一息|ひといき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: in a single breath (same meaning)
- {一息|ひといき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to drink in one gulp

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ひと{休|やす}み→ひと休み：07782_hitoyasumi⟧: a short rest (slightly longer break implied)
- ⟦{息抜|いきぬ}き→息抜き：16698_ikinuki⟧: relaxation, taking a break (more general)

COMPOUND: {一|ひと} (one) + ⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧ (breath)
